headline: Build vs. buy,
rewritten.
dek: AI makes building your own GTM tools realistic again. After a decade of unbundling, the stack is getting a rethink.

callouts.title: Bundle
callouts.text: One platform did it all. Think Salesforce.

callouts.title: Unbundle
callouts.text: A point tool for every job: the "$50K GTM stack."

callouts.title: Paper cuts
callouts.text: Subscriptions pile up like a new cable bill.

callouts.title: Rebuild
callouts.text: Teams build CRMs and agents in Claude instead.

side.title: In the field
side.text: One of Quinn's customers had already built the tool he pitched. Another is buying an AI agent instead.

sources: Fringe Lines podcast, Oct 30, 2026. "How to choose" is Fringe Lines' take.
